final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT t.account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3), step2 AS (SELECT region, SUM(total_amount) AS region_total FROM step1 GROUP BY region) SELECT s1.account_id, s1.region, s1.total_amount, s1.record_count, CAST(s1.total_amount AS REAL) / NULLIF(s2.region_total, 0) AS share FROM step1 AS s1 JOIN step2 AS s2 ON s1.region COLLATE BINARY = s2.region COLLATE BINARY ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10
